caption: The worked example's four is-active readings in order: inactive, active, active, inactive. The two shaded stages show the change behind them — the first start gives Main PID 812, and the restart gives a new Main PID 947 — for a tally of 2 active and 2 inactive.

spec.title: is-active readings on the lab server
spec.aria: A downward flow of the worked example's four stages: before anything is-active prints inactive; after systemctl start nginx it prints active with Main PID 812; after systemctl restart nginx it prints active with a new Main PID 947; after systemctl stop nginx it prints inactive again, giving two active and two inactive readings.
